name: Wall Seated Side Crunch
steps: Lean against a wall, step your feet forward and slide down until your thighs approach horizontal.
Keep your hips supported and rest your fingertips lightly beside your ears.
Bend strictly sideways along the wall to bring one elbow smoothly down toward your same-side hip, squeezing your oblique tightly.
Straighten back to center, then switch sides.
tips: Slide strictly in the sideways plane against the wall without letting your shoulder peel forward or twisting your chest.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands as you crunch sideways.
